title: Card
description: Generic bordered surface container. Promoted out of the summary-card family when the SCOUT report timeline became its second consumer.

anatomy.description: A div with data-slot="card": bark-50 surface, bark-200 hairline border, the house radius. Accepts any div props and a className to extend.

usage: Compose content inside; Card owns only the surface, border and radius, never padding conventions of its children.
Prefer extending Card over drawing a bordered box in a route or feature module.
Promotion precedent: a private descendant becomes a top-level component like this one when a second, unrelated component needs it.
